```ts sdk-signature
}
```

### ExitCluster {#ExitCluster}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">exits.ExitCluster</code></div>

The parts of a cluster lock exit verification needs.

```ts sdk-signature
interface ExitCluster {
  operators: Array<{
    enr: string;
  }>;
  forkVersion: string;

    distributedPublicKey: string;
    publicShares: string[];
  }>;
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>operators</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Array&lt;{ enr: string }&gt;</span> | In lock order: operator `share_idx` is `operators[share_idx - 1]`. |

</div>

### ExitsModule {#ExitsModule}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">exits.ExitsModule</code></div>

The exits module bound to a client context: `aggregate` takes `chainId`
from the client.

```ts sdk-signature
interface ExitsModule {
  assertPartialExit: typeof assertPartialExit;
  aggregate: (
    input: Omit<AggregateInput, 'chainId'>,

  blsAggregate: typeof blsAggregate;
  blsThresholdAggregate: typeof blsThresholdAggregate;
  blsRecoverPubkey: typeof blsRecoverPubkey;
}
```
